note: Supplementary cases for contract amendment A2 (contract commit 6a92d5ee), co-evolved with the tool and written by the BuildJobRunwayTool seat. They cover the YAML forms omp reads differently from the line grammar of rule 1 (the forms listed in .ufo/waves/round-25/w1/CriticC2Rules.md, F4). Every form the tool cannot read the way omp reads it is an abstention: `malformed` / `RUNWAY_UNKNOWN` / exit 2, never a number. The BOM case expects the normal value because A2 strips a leading byte-order mark. These cases are loaded with `--cases tools/fixtures/mori-job-runway/supplementary-cases.json`; the frozen 21 cases stay the declared after-value and this file is not counted toward it.

cases.what: quoted top-level async key: the tool cannot read it the way omp reads it
space before the colon in the async key
a leading UTF-8 byte-order mark is stripped, so the file is read normally
quoted direct child key: maxJobs after quotes, but not written exactly maxJobs:
merge key inside the async block
explicit (complex) key inside the async block
two async blocks: the tool cannot know which one omp reads
a # that is not preceded by whitespace does not open a comment
a document marker line anywhere in the file
a tab in the indentation of a line of the async block
a quoted scalar spanning lines hides a maxJobs line
a maxJobs value opening a quote
a maxJobs value opening a block scalar
guard: a # preceded by whitespace still opens a comment, so the value is read
guard: an inline async mapping is still malformed
